name: Templates
description: Templates is a browsable library of ready-made image and video templates. Pick one, add your media, and generate. It has 292 templates in total: 52 standard templates in 8 categories and 240 industry (niche) video templates.
shortDescription: Ready-made templates: pick one, add your media, generate.
fullDescription: Templates (route #/templates) shows the line "Ready-to-use templates. Pick one, add your media, and generate." Under it are a "Search templates..." box, filter chips (All, Standard, the template categories, then a divider and the industry/niche names), a short how-to strip, and sections of template cards. Each card has a thumbnail, an icon, the template name, a one-line description and a small "Video" or "Image" tag. Clicking a card opens it in the Template Studio at #/template/<template id> (the side-menu highlight stays on Templates). The library currently holds 292 templates (counted from the code): 52 standard templates (Social Media, Style Transfer, Entertainment, Commercial, VFX & Action, Portrait & Creator, Decade & Era, Camera & Cinematic) and 240 industry templates across 12 industries. The studio has Media Sources, AI Enhancer, Advanced controls, Generate, Download and Regenerate.
bestFor: Getting a polished look or format fast without writing a long prompt: social videos and thumbnails, style conversions, product shots, VFX moments, and promo videos for local businesses.
whenToUse: You have a photo and want a specific effect (anime, Ghibli, explosion, 1980s style).
You want a ready-made social format (TikTok, Reel, thumbnail, banner).
You run a local business (restaurant, salon, dental office, real estate and so on) and want a promo or brand film.
whenToUseAnother: For free-form images from a text prompt, use Image Studio (#/image).
For free-form videos, use Video Studio (#/video).
For cinematic shots with camera/lens controls, use Cinema Studio (#/cinema) or Cinema Templates (#/cinema-template).
keyFeatures: Search box "Search templates..." that filters cards by name, description, category, output type and niche.
Filter chips: All, Standard, categories, and an industry group after a "|" divider.
Industry sections are marked "Industry" with a count and a cyan style.
Template Studio with Model picker, Media Sources, AI Enhancer, Advanced controls, Generate, Download, Publish to Social, Regenerate.
Four output tabs: Enhanced Prompt, Scene Beats, Voiceover, Negative Prompt.

featureExplanations.explanation: Eight categories with 52 templates: Social Media (8), Style Transfer (9), Entertainment (9), Commercial (6), VFX & Action (6), Portrait & Creator (6), Decade & Era (4), Camera & Cinematic (4). Full lists are in the FAQ.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: Most standard templates ask for "Upload your photo" and a description; some (such as YouTube Thumbnail, Movie Poster, Billboard Ad) are text-to-image.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Each template is tied to a default model (for example kling-v2.6-pro-i2v for most video templates).

featureExplanations.explanation: 240 video templates across 12 industries: Restaurant & Cafe, Med Spa & Beauty, Salon & Barbershop, Gym & Fitness, Real Estate, Dental Office, Chiropractic & Wellness, Legal & Attorney, Automotive & Car, Fashion & Style, Events & Celebrations, Luxury & Premium. Each industry has two sets of 10. Examples: Restaurant & Cafe: Midnight Table Film, Signature Plate Showcase, Opening Night Trailer; Med Spa & Beauty: Velvet Glow Film; Salon & Barbershop: Final Cut Film; Gym & Fitness: Iron Frame Film; Real Estate: Open Door Film; Dental Office: Smile Frame Film; Legal: Authority Case Film; Automotive: Chrome Story Film; Luxury: House of Light Film. The second set is named per industry (for example Salon Brand Film, Salon Process Doc, Salon Transformation, Salon Testimonial) and shows under lowercase industry headings such as "salon" and "real-estate" in the All view.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Ready-made business storytelling for local-service brands.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: A description of your business or scene; the Advanced controls (Niche, Business Type, Audience, Subject, Setting, Visual Style, CTA) refine it.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Lowercase-named sections only show under All.

featureExplanations.feature: Template Studio: Model and Media Sources
featureExplanations.explanation: The Model picker shows "Model · <route>" where the route is Text → Video, Image → Video, Video → Video, Text → Image or Image → Image. For video templates, "Media Sources" lets you add a reference image (turns the run into image-to-video) or a source video (video-to-video); a badge shows which route Generate will take.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Choose a different model or feed your own media.
featureExplanations.inputRequired: Image templates and image-to-video templates need an image: otherwise you see "Please upload an image before generating."
featureExplanations.restrictions: If you pick a model that cannot take your attached media, the studio falls back to the first model for that route and says so.

featureExplanations.explanation: A toggle that is ON by default. It auto-detects the niche, applies cinematic prompt expansion, scene logic and cleanup in the background. Turn it OFF to send a rawer prompt.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Per the user guide, enhancer keywords are cinematic/4K style words added to your prompt.

featureExplanations.explanation: Opened with the Advanced button. Fields: Template Type (video templates only), Niche, Business Type, Audience, Subject, Setting, Visual Style (luxury, dramatic, documentary, commercial), CTA, and Extra Instructions.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: Steer the story, tone and call to action.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Template Type is hidden for image templates.

featureExplanations.explanation: Right panel tabs: Enhanced Prompt (final prompt sent), Scene Beats (story structure), Voiceover (suggested script for video templates), Negative Prompt (what to avoid). A wand button next to the editable output enhances the text.
featureExplanations.whyToUse: See and tweak exactly what the AI receives; borrow the voiceover script.
featureExplanations.restrictions: Editable text; changes apply to what you generate next.

howToUse: 1. Open Templates from the left side menu. 2. Search with "Search templates..." or click a filter chip (All, Standard, a category, or an industry after the divider). 3. Click a template card to open it in the Template Studio. 4. Fill in the inputs the template shows (for example "Upload your photo" and a description) and, for video templates, add Media Sources if you want. 5. Leave AI Enhancer on (default) or turn it off. 6. Optionally open Advanced controls. 7. Press Generate. 8. When it finishes, use Download, Publish to Social or Regenerate. Results are also saved in Library.
howToSteps: Open Templates from the left side menu.
Search or filter and click a template card.
Upload your photo or enter the description/inputs shown.
Check the Model picker and AI Enhancer toggle.
Press Generate and wait; press Cancel during generation if you need to stop.
Download, Regenerate or find the result in Library.
gettingStarted: Try "Anime Converter" or "TikTok Video Creator" for a quick first result: upload a photo, add a short description, press Generate.
Save your MuAPI key first; without it a key prompt appears when you press Generate.
inputs: Description / prompt (min about 10 characters per the user guide)
Aspect Ratio and Duration selects (some video templates: aspect 9:16, 16:9, 1:1; duration 5, 8 or 10 for TikTok-style templates)
requiredInputs: Photo for image-to-image and image-to-video templates

inputDetails.name: Upload your photo
inputDetails.description: Your starting image for image-based templates.
inputDetails.restrictions: Text-to-image templates (for example YouTube Thumbnail, Movie Poster) do not need a photo.

inputDetails.name: Description / Describe the video
inputDetails.description: Short text of what you want, with a placeholder example such as "dancing in the rain".
inputDetails.restrictions: The user guide says a prompt under 10 characters triggers "Please enter a longer prompt".

modeExplanations.description: Generates an image from your text only.
Transforms your uploaded photo with a prompt and effect name.
modeExplanations.useCase: Style transfer, decade looks, face/age effects, product shots.

modelCapabilities: Most standard video templates default to kling-v2.6-pro-i2v; image templates default to models such as nano-banana, image-effects, flux-kontext-effects, ai-ghibli-style, ai-product-shot and ai-image-face-swap. You can change the model in the Template Studio Model picker; only models compatible with the current route (text/image/video input) are offered. Extend works only on Seedance 2.0 videos.
outputs: A generated image or video shown in the preview, plus Enhanced Prompt, Scene Beats, Voiceover and Negative Prompt text.
Saved automatically to Library; history strip of past template results.
limitations: Some industry category chips can show an empty list.

limitationDetails.impact: Chips named after industries that appear before the "|" divider (for example Industry Specific, Personal Story) filter standard templates only, and all industry templates carry an industry tag, so the list can be empty.
limitationDetails.workaround: Use the industry chips after the "|" divider, or choose All.

troubleshooting: "Please upload an image before generating.": add a photo in the template input.
"Please upload a video before generating.": you chose the video-to-video route; attach a source video or remove it.
"Please enter a prompt or description before generating.": fill the description field.
"Please enter a longer prompt": add more words.
"No output URL returned" or placeholder warning: try again; if repeated, change the model.

troubleshootingSteps.issue: Generate does nothing / asks for a key
steps: Add your Muapi API Key in Settings (labelled "Muapi API Key").

exampleWorkflows.title: Anime version of a photo
steps: Upload your photo and add a description.

faqs.question: How many templates are there?
faqs.answer: 292 in the code: 52 standard templates and 240 industry templates (12 industries x 10 x 2 sets).

faqs.question: What template categories and templates exist?
faqs.answer: Standard categories and templates: Social Media (8): TikTok Video Creator, Instagram Reel Generator, YouTube Thumbnail, Reaction Thumbnail, Short-Form Ad, Story Highlight Cover, Profile Picture Generator, Banner Creator. Style Transfer (9): Anime Converter, Comic Book Style, GTA Loading Screen, Pixel Art Creator, Ghibli Style, Cyberpunk Style, VHS Retro, Film Noir, Glass Ball. Entertainment (9): Movie Poster, Magazine Cover, Bullet Time Scene, Action Figure, Disney / Pixar Style, Superhero Transform, Lego Style, Squid Game Style, 3D Figurine. Commercial (6): Product Hero Shot, Product Photography, Billboard Ad, ASMR Video, Product Placement, Unboxing Scene. VFX & Action (6): Building Explosion, Car Explosion, Disintegration, Electricity / Lightning, Tornado, Fire Breath. Portrait & Creator (6): Face Swap, Gender Swap, Age Progression, Younger Self, Fashion Stride, Glamour Portrait. Decade & Era (4): 1920s Style, 1950s Style, 1970s Style, 1980s Style. Camera & Cinematic (4): Drone FPV Shot, Dolly Zoom, Car Chase Scene, Matrix Shot. Industries: Restaurant & Cafe, Med Spa & Beauty, Salon & Barbershop, Gym & Fitness, Real Estate, Dental Office, Chiropractic & Wellness, Legal & Attorney, Automotive & Car, Fashion & Style, Events & Celebrations, Luxury & Premium.

faqs.question: What does AI Enhancer do?
faqs.answer: It is ON by default and expands your prompt with cinematic detail, scene logic and cleanup. Turn it off for a raw prompt.

faqs.question: Do I need an API key?
faqs.answer: Yes, a Muapi API Key saved in Settings. Without it a key prompt appears when you press Generate.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Templates and Cinema Templates?
faqs.answer: Templates (#/templates) is this library. Cinema Templates (#/cinema-template) is a separate app in the Video group for ready-made cinematic templates.
